$comment: Full end-to-end: the real Azure, Octopus and Coralogix adapters, pointed at local
emulators. Only the base URLs differ from a production file — the providers, their
mapping, their paging and their auth are the production code paths.
bun run db:up        # Postgres and floci-az
bun run seed:azure   # floci-az starts empty; without this the estate is blank
bun run dev:stack    # Octopus, Coralogix and the Azure cost mock
The Azure provider declares seven of the nine cloud capabilities. Regions, nodes,
clusters and spend come from ARM and Cost Management; utilisation, storage and
databases are Azure Monitor readings, which floci-az answers with "Unsupported
Microsoft.Compute path" — so `bun run dev:stack` serves them from a Monitor mock
on 4594. Queues and alerts stay undeclared and render as stated gaps: Service Bus
will not provision through floci-az at all, and alerts are Monitor's alerts API
rather than its metrics one. No SOURCES_ALLOW_FIXTURES here — nothing in this
